search_text.text:
Bloom's progress from the end of Calypso to the start of Hades:
  his home on Eccles Street (blue arrow), Sir John Rogerson's Quay
  where Lotus Eaters begins (orange), and Paddy Dignam's house in
  Sandymount (red), shown on a simplified map of Dublin drawn by
  Hanni Bailey. Source: Chester Anderson, James Joyce.
